description: This file is a shell script for testing Git notes fanout restructuring. It includes test cases defining workflows for adding, removing, and verifying notes on commits, including fanout behavior in the note storage structure.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has the specified fanout level

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Simulates adding or deleting a note and checks for correct fanout structure

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies that all notes in a given revision have the specified fanout
